image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a metallic disposable lighter lying on its side on a rough concrete surface. The lighter has a silver/chrome finish with black accents near the top. The ignition wheel and nozzle are clearly visible in the foreground. The background is blurred (bokeh), showing hints of greenery and brickwork.

artifact_observations.location: Black band on the lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The black graphic/print on the upper part of the lighter body lacks sharp definition and appears slightly smeared or melted into the chrome casing, lacking the crisp edges expected of printed enamel or plastic molding.

The connection point between the serrated flint wheel and the main body housing appears slightly indistinct. The geometry of the wheel's axle area seems to merge softly with the casing rather than having a distinct mechanical separation.

The background blur is extremely aggressive and somewhat unnatural, with shapes that don't fully resolve into coherent objects, typical of AI-generated depth-of-field effects, though not structurally critical.

To audit the boundary sharpness between the metal wheel and the plastic/metal casing, checking for the 'melting' artifact observed by the Router.
To verify the contact shadow and physical grounding of the lighter on the concrete, ensuring it doesn't appear to float or have inconsistent lighting.

Boundary definition between the black print and silver casing
